Fixed. The javac `HandleHelper` didn't handle a helper class declared directly in a method body — `annotatedType.directUp()` returns the method declaration, and `getStatementsFromJcNode` only handled blocks/case statements, returning null and triggering the "legal only on method-local classes" error. I added `JCMethodDecl` handling to both `getStatementsFromJcNode` and `setStatementsOfJcNode` in src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleHelper.java:69 (mirroring what the eclipse handler already did with `AbstractMethodDeclaration`).

- `ant test.eclipse-202212`: full ecj suite passes (PASS_TO_PASS)
